title: api.v4.RunForUpdate
description: Run represents an external CI/CD run from a third-party tool.

runNumber.description: run number, uniquely identifies an execution of a workflow

url.description: run URL in the original external system

actorEmail.description: email address of the user who triggered the run

status.description: run status; accepted values: PENDING, PAUSED, STARTED, FAILED, ERRORED, ABORTED, SUCCEEDED, PENDING_APPROVAL, TIMED_OUT, APPROVED, REJECTED, APPROVAL_TIMED_OUT, SKIPPED, UNSCHEDULED, UNSTABLE

statusMessage.description: run status message (normally specifying the failure cause)

externalParentFlow.description: external system identifier to group related runs under a common pipeline or workflow

statusReason.description:
status_reason is "POLICY" when a policy gate caused the current status, otherwise empty.
 Note: CloudBees-native runs never report PENDING_APPROVAL as their run status on this API,
 so in practice this identifies a policy-caused failure.
